newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Wednesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Wednesday:

In response to a question about Italy's planned "Euro tax", spokesman Patrick Child said the Commission's economic forecasts released two weeks ago were based on an Italian tax of 0.5 percent of GDP. He said Eurostat would review the initiative but that the Commission attached importance to the sustainable character of convergence.
Spokesman Peter Guilford said the legal results from the panel discussion that took place in China at the beginning of this week were private and would not be given to the press.

In answer to questions asked throughout the previous week in his absence Guilford said that human rights issues had been discussed with various Chinese authorities. He also said that potential Chinese membership to the WTO would help human rights in China.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1040: Cohesion policy and culture: how to use culture for job creation.
- IP/96/1041: Green paper on EU/ACP relations: a new partnership for the 21st century.
- IP/96/1042: Communication on copyright and related rights in the information society.
- IP/96/1043: Public procurement: Commission modifies proposals to amend EU rules to take account of GPA.
- IP/96/1046: Commission adopts a communication on state aids elements in public land sales.
- IP/96/1048: State aid: The Netherlands - the Commission decides to investigate research & development aid to OCE Nederland BV.
- IP/96/1049: Commission to recover a further ECU 67.5 million of 1992 CAP expenditure from the member states.
- IP/96/1051: Action plan on fighting trafficking in women for sexual purposes.
- IP/96/1056: Commissioner Christos Papoutsis's statement on the electrical interconnection Italy-Greece.
- "The first action plan for innovation in Europe - Innovation for growth and employment".
- Draft programme for the seminar on the prevention of urban delinquency linked to drugs dependence.
- Towards the fifth framework programme: additional material for the policy debate - Commission working paper.
- Communication from the Commission on "The cohesion policy and culture, a contribution to employment".
- Taxes and duties at October 1996 in Ecus and in national currencies.
- EUR 16961: Invent tomorrow, orientation for the 5th framework-programme.
- Oil bulletin No 845.
- ME96/20.11: Midday express.
